subject: Invoice window ladder proposal & vendor setup (FastEdge)

From: Elena Soto <elena@fastedge.io>

Cc: AP-Payables <ap@fastedge.io>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: move to Net45 + early-pay ladder option

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — FastEdge is excited to move forward. Before we complete the vendor onboarding, our finance team wanted to propose a billing cadence that works for both sides. Currently we invoice on receipt / Net30, but to smooth cash flow at scale we'd like to move to Net45 with an optional early-pay ladder we can offer to Redwood:

- Net45 standard on all invoices
- 2.0% discount if Redwood pays within 10 days for invoices < $20k
- 1.5% discount if paid within 10 days for invoices between $20k–$50k
- No discount for invoices > $50k (negotiable)

Attached is a short spreadsheet with examples and our W-9. Can you confirm what Redwood needs to complete vendor setup (vendor form, PO timing, remit instructions)? We can accept POs, and would prefer invoice cutoff on the 15th/last of the month or per PO — open to alignment.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director of Finance
FastEdge Inc.
Attachments: Payment_Ladder_Proposal.xlsx, FastEdge_W9.pdf

Thanks Sean — copied the onboarding checklist below and next steps. We need the following to register FastEdge in our AP system and issue the first PO:

Required from vendor:
- Completed Vendor Onboarding Form (attached PDF; vendor to fill and return)
- W-9 (received)
- Bank remit (ACH) + voided check or bank letter

Internal approvals/ops:
- Finance (Monica) to validate tax info and bank details
- Legal (Rishi) to review any non-standard payment language — the 2%/1.5% early-pay ladder is commercial; we usually allow early-pay discounts but want to confirm thresholds
- Procurement (Marissa) to create vendor record and enable PO routing

Operational notes:
- PO issuance: we can do per-PO timing or monthly POs. If you want invoice cutoff alignment, recommend PO terms that reference invoice date ranges (e.g., PO#12345 covers Feb 1–28).
- DocuSign link: we use DocuSign for vendor agreements when needed (see link).

Elena — please return the completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and bank remit. Once I confirm the ACH details, we'll register FastEdge and Marissa will issue a sample PO so you can confirm the invoice cutoff fields.

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks — attached are the completed onboarding form and a bank letter with ACH details. Confirming operational preferences:

- We prefer monthly POs aligned to calendar month with invoice cutoff on the last calendar day. That keeps our billing simple.
- We accept Net45 once vendor record is active.
- Early-pay ladder we can honor as follows: 2.0% if paid within 10 days for invoices < $20k; 1.5% if paid within 10 days for invoices between $20k–$50k. For invoices > $50k, we don’t offer discount but can discuss case-by-case.

Files attached: FastEdge_W9.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, FastEdge_BANK_LETTER.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else and we can get the PO/Routing test started.

- Early-pay ladder accepted operationally: 2.0% within 10 days for invoices < $20k; 1.5% within 10 days for $20k–$50k. Larger invoices handled case-by-case and require executive sign-off.

- Marissa: issue a sample PO (PO-RED-FFX-0001) covering Mar 1–31 so FastEdge can confirm invoice cutoff fields (target: by 2027-02-28).
- Rishi: confirm legal is OK with the discount ladder language or flag any standard clause changes (target: 2027-03-02).
- Elena: confirm receipt of sample PO and invoice test once issued.

If anyone needs to escalate the discount thresholds for larger deals we'll bring finance + sales execs in, but this should let operations proceed. Thanks all — Sean, please mark as green with the FastEdge commercial team.
